column2: Requirements held as items with stable identifiers
Coverage as a live view rather than an export
Risk model linked to requirements and controls
Design history file or technical file as a live view
Quality management in the same validated system
Customer self configuration without a services engagement

Migration path and effort, stated in hours
Total cost at year two with real seat count
Audit trail an assessor can walk in under a minute
